crossRefs.note: How long, God, shall the adversary reproach? Shall the enemy blaspheme your name forever?
Relent, Yahweh! How long? Have compassion on your servants!
Yahweh, how long will the wicked, how long will the wicked triumph?
Your country is desolate. Your cities are burned with fire. Strangers devour your land in your presence and it is…
Her gates shall lament and mourn. She shall be desolate and sit on the ground.
Behold, Yahweh makes the earth empty, makes it waste, turns it upside down, and scatters its inhabitants.

translations.web: Then I said, “Lord, how long?” He answered, “Until cities are waste without inhabitant, houses without man, the land becomes utterly waste,
translations.bsb: Then I asked: “How long, O Lord?” And He replied: “Until the cities lie ruined and without inhabitant, until the houses are left unoccupied and the land is desolate and ravaged,
translations.kjv: Then said I, Lord, how long? And he answered, Until the cities be wasted without inhabitant, and the houses without man, and the land be utterly desolate,
translations.asv: Then said I, Lord, how long? And he answered, Until cities be waste without inhabitant, and houses without man, and the land become utterly waste,
